request.name: reference_video_path
request.description: Masked video identifying the target source; frames are matched to audio by nearest timestamp. Requires libav runtime libraries. Mutually exclusive with reference_image_path.

request.name: reference_image_path
request.description: Masked RGB image identifying the target sound source, used as a constant visual prompt throughout the recording. Mask unwanted regions before supplying the image.

request.name: anchors
request.description: Optional JSON array of time spans: [["+", start_seconds, end_seconds], ["-", start_seconds, end_seconds]]. Positive spans identify the target; negative spans identify sounds to exclude.

request.name: seed
request.description: Random seed; -1 selects a random seed.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Midpoint integration steps; each step evaluates the denoiser twice.

session.name: memory_bounded
session.description: Experimental bounded-workspace execution with full recording context. Provisional option name.
